notes: An unexpected error no longer freezes the caller. Until now any error StandBy didn't expect put up a "JavaScript error" box: GO stopped, every screen showed HOST LOST until someone clicked OK. StandBy now writes it to a log, shows an amber banner (*Something went wrong inside StandBy. The show is still running.*) and carries on. Help › Show Error Log opens the log. New: Show › Pre-show Check… (and a Pre-show check button on the caller screen until the first GO). In a few seconds it looks at this Mac's address against the Sheet's HOST_IP, the follow port, Bonjour, the Local Network…
